Jordan: Quick check — proposing an after-action roundup for the Tue infra blip. Need to lock attendees, agenda, and prework. Two options: Wed 10:00 or Thu 15:00. Duration 30–45m. Who should be there?
Mira: I can facilitate if folks want me to. Wed 10:00 works better for me. Agenda suggestion: 1) timeline (10m) 2) impact/customer pain (5m) 3) root cause + gaps (15m) 4) action triage + owners (10m). Prework = timeline doc + logs linked in thread.
Sam: Thu 15:00 is slightly better for me. Agree on the agenda though — add a short "observability gaps" slot inside root cause.
Lia: I can run invites. If we pick Wed I'll need final attendee list by EOD today. Also recommend inviting product (Kira) and infra lead (Ravi).
Jordan: Good call — @Kira @Ravi can you join? We mainly need product impact context and infra postmortem input.
Kira: I can join for first half (timeline + impact). Not available for the full slot but will add notes to timeline doc if I have to drop.
Ravi: I'll be there. Please include the kernel/pod logs link in prework.
Mira: For prework — please add any timeline items + links to traces/logs here: https://redwood.internal/docs/incidents/2026-02-blip/timeline (one-liner per event).
Sam: I'll take notes and create the action-triage spreadsheet during the call. After the meeting I'll convert actions to tickets with owners + due dates.
Jordan: Rotate facilitation next month — Mira first this time. Sam notes. Lia will schedule and set a short agenda in the calendar invite.
Lia: Scheduling now. Tentatively putting Wed 10:00 30m with goal: finalize actions and owners. Will set "required" for SRE, Runtime, Product PD, Oncall owner.
Sam: Can we also decide on our follow-up cadence? Propose 1-week async checkpoint in the action tracker and a 3-week review for regressions.
Mira: +1 to 1-week checkpoint. Add a label "postmortem-action" to issues so we can filter.
Jordan: Prework deadline = EOD tomorrow for timeline additions. If you add anything after that, flag it in the doc.
Lia: Invite sent (tentative). See calendar note: "After-action roundup — bring timeline & evidence. Prework due EOD tomorrow."
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — this channel will receive a ping 24h before the meeting.
Sam: I'll prep the action-triage template now and link it in the doc.
Mira: One more ask: include one concrete acceptance criteria per action (e.g., "alerts added + tested", "dashboard created"). Helps reduce ambiguity.
Jordan: Agreed. After meeting: Sam -> create tickets; Lia -> validate invite list; Mira -> run follow-up first checkpoint. I'll compile final attendee list and hand off facilitation notes.
Kira: Thanks. If anything changes ping me here.
Ravi: I'll paste the pod logs link in the timeline doc in 30m.
Jordan: OK, consensus reached. Wed 10:00, 30–45m, Mira facilitator, Sam notetaker, prework due EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Mira: :thumbsup:
Lia: I'll mark the invite as "tentative" until end of day.
Sam: Will post the action-triage link in 10m.
ops-bot: follow-up reminder: action-triage template posted (link: https://redwood.internal/tools/action-triage).
